guards.maps_to: events/tinker_time.py:42-50 `_take_random_2` and its two callers (:53, :66). TakeRandom(n, rng) is literally `ToList().UnstableShuffle(rng).Take(n)` (IEnumerableExtensions.cs:17-20), and UnstableShuffle (ListExtensions.cs:44-60) is top-down Fisher-Yates taking NextInt(i+1) for i = n-1 .. 1. rng.Rng.shuffle (rng.py:270-273) is the identical loop, so this is the right primitive rather than a nearby one -- NOT an EV-5 site. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes_b.py draws`): the two TakeRandom(2) calls over 3-element lists consume 4 draws off the event Rng in both. Order matters here and is preserved: the offered order is what a recording's `ChooseEventOption <n>` indexes into, and the sim's input lists are in source order -- `list(_TYPE_RIDERS)` is [ATTACK, SKILL, POWER] (tinker_time.py:15-19) matching TinkerTime.cs:79-81, and each rider triple matches TinkerTime.cs:117-134.
